title: H3 Chunk
description: One 4-15 s MiniMax H3 clip of a scene: the anchor keeps the place and positions, up to 5 character sheets and 2 props keep the faces.

labels.211:audio: Voice track (this chunk's slice of the episode audio)

hints: Output length is exactly round(24 x DURATION) frames at 24 fps (6.3 s -> 151 frames). H3 renders the next 17k+5 frame count (6.3 s -> 158) and the workflow trims it.

The anchor is <Picture 1>; filled character slots follow in slot order as <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> ... The workflow writes this list in front of the prompt, so call people 'character 1', 'character 2' and describe them by look.

Multi-shot in one clip: write the shots in the prompt and, for frame-exact cuts, give one keyframe per shot plus SHOT CUT FRAMES. Without keyframes H3 makes clean hard cuts but places them up to ~1.5 s off the asked times.
With a voice track and LIPS FOLLOW AUDIO on, write who speaks and when, e.g. "Maya speaks 'line' at 3.2-5.0 s; nobody else's lips move". The clip's sound is then the voice track itself.
The size comes from the studio's resolution and shape: 480p or 768p, landscape, portrait or square.
